name: sol-advisor
description: Haru fork of Sol Advisor with a High-default primary effort preflight and Sol-led bounded model-pinned delegation.

interface.shortDescription: Sol starts High, gates Medium vs High pre-tool, then uses bounded Luna delegation.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor starts GPT-6.1 Sol / High by default and performs a tool-free primary-effort gate before substantive work. Bounded low-to-moderate-risk tasks are redirected to a fresh GPT-6.1 Sol / Medium task rather than changing effort in-session. After the primary effort matches, GPT-6.1 Sol owns architecture, decomposition, integration, escalation, and final acceptance. GPT-6 Luna / Max explorer, worker, tester, and researcher roles are preferred for substantial bounded workstreams that can be instructed independently, with low fanout and compact evidence reuse. GPT-5.6 Terra / High remains a judgment-heavy implementation exception, and fresh GPT-6.1 Sol / High review remains a high-risk final gate. Model pins, fork_turns: none, runtime evidence checks, and fail-closed installation are preserved.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to run the PRIMARY EFFORT gate before task tools. Start from Sol / High by default; if the task is medium-recommended, stop and restart it as a fresh Sol / Medium task instead of switching effort in-session.

After the primary effort matches, declare the SELECTIVE ROUTE; keep architecture and final acceptance in Sol, delegate only bounded work that substitutes for primary execution, normally keep fanout at 0-1, and reserve Terra and fresh Sol review for explicit exception cases.
